target.title: chore: Implement a graceful shutdown sequence for the Node server

source_evidence.finding: production Nest bootstrap has no SIGTERM/SIGINT path; owns HTTP bootstrap plus standalone rate-limit Redis reference and drops IndexerJob instance
cron task handle and simulated in-flight timeout are not retained; no stop/shutdown contract exists
standalone ioredis client for rate limiting is outside Nest lifecycle and uses reconnect strategy
Nest-owned publisher/subscriber clients disconnect through onModuleDestroy
Prisma disconnects through onModuleDestroy, requiring Nest teardown rather than process.exit immediately after raw server close
RedisModule and PrismaModule are part of the production Nest application lifecycle
Nest WebSocket gateway subscribes through Nest-owned RedisService; application close is the natural teardown boundary
start:prod targets dist/main; Jest/Supertest exist; advertised test:e2e config path is absent on pinned main
existing colocated integration tests demonstrate Nest app lifecycle/testing seam with app.close()
legacy standalone WebSocket server already uses SIGTERM but exits immediately after wss.close(); it is not the production Nest start target and should not be copied
